problem: Dispatch and returns. Four dispatch templates, a three-layer render (role file, project template, per-unit fill) and four return schemas (worker-return with halt kinds, explorer-return, critic-findings, verifier-verdict) exist, with a validator and fc return storing returns. The core spec keeps the sealed dispatch, commits it before spawn, captures the return by hook, and moves the schemas under schemas/run.

questions.text: Are the four return shapes kept as they are, so the suite pins their fields?
questions.why: The core spec reuses all four schemas by path. If their fields are stable, a conforming and a non-conforming document per shape is a cheap deterministic pin; if halt kinds or fields will change, only the rule that a return validates is stable.

options.value: Kept as they are: pin each shape with a conforming and a refused document.
Expected to change: pin only that every return validates against a schema and an invalid one is refused.

questions.text: Is today's rendering the kept behaviour, or only the sealed-dispatch rule?
questions.why: Today fc worker render fills the template from the plan unit; the rule is that nothing outside a slot reaches the worker and the rendered prompt is a file.

options.value: The rule: a rendered dispatch contains only slot content from its three layers and is written as a file; the suite proves that through today's render.
Today's rendering exactly: pin the template text and the filled output.
